title: BioIVT SHORTFORM ethnicity is shown for human donors only
description: Hides the ethnicity question on SHORTFORM unless the first question, 'Is this a Human subject?', is answered Yes. Same rule RACE already uses. Without it, ETH showed for animal donors and before the question was answered.
rationale: Verified in the built Detroit form 2026-10-04: RACE has relevant = ${IS_IT_A_VETERINARY_FORM}='Yes' but ETH had no rule. Scoped to SHORTFORM only: FOLLOWUP and OUTCOME have no such gate question, so the rule would reference a field that is not on those forms. Approved by Dan 2026-10-04.
source: Detroit SHORTFORM RACE rule; approved by Dan

history.note: Closes the gap where the ethnicity question appeared on animal records.
